title: Claude Just Got a Major Upgrade (Audit Your Prompts)
description: Anthropic shipped Claude Fable 5.1 this week, with launch-week reporting citing big jumps on long coding jobs, research, and knowledge work, a record score on a third-party intelligence index, and VentureBeat confirming the launch date plus a 75% cut on cache-read costs. Models are not cleanly versioned software, so a prompt tuned to one model's quirks can quietly degrade on the next, which is why Anthropic's own Claude Code team cut its system prompt 80% for Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, and OpenAI now recommends leaner prompts for GPT-5.6 too. Run your 3-5 most-used saved prompts through the new model once and check the output, a two-minute audit, not a rebuild. Free Starter 10: link in profile.
